versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Units hide face down as Lids, unseen and untouchable, and spring out mid-fight after a set number of enemy attacks.
Knocks speed the springs up; payoffs reward springing often or waiting to the end, and Lids can hide other tribes' units too.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Fixed rules gaps: Corkhinge always springs last and only by the fallback, summons never land on a Lid's slot, and the Grand Tyler springs the leftmost hand card with its Spring: effect.
Diadem's wording now says which unit retreats, and golden Atypus retreats six times a fight so tripling him is worth it.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
